name: Mercan Balığı
scene: A big friendly tropical fish swims among bubbles over a sandy sea floor.
notes: Design sheet only; target 85–125 panes. Fish, fins, tail and eye use the orange/gold pair; water, bubbles, aquatic foliage and seabed use blue/teal. Generated with fox and lighthouse design references; original fish artwork informed the subject. Inspected both attempts and regenerated once to improve crossing seams and replace transparent exterior with white. Final visual review: closed oval rim and closed panes, no obvious loose line ends; colour pairs remain separate. Remaining doubts: subtle fill shading persists, some same-colour adjacent panes may merge during tracing, and close multi-arm contacts at fin roots, tail root and lower foliage need geometry-stage review. Pane count and junction validity are not certified by this design sheet.
